text:
emily: Heads-up runtime — final webinar dry-run tomorrow. Can we get a focused sanity sweep on the quantized chat model we're demoing? Need cold-start, cache-miss tails, and a tiny randomized stability probe. Prefer Dedicated if available.

tyler_runtime: yes. give me the payload pointer, model pin, and which slices to capture. Target runtime budget?

emily: payload: s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/demo-pack-v6.json (40 prompts: 25 short, 15 long, 8 adversarial chains). model pin: `redwood-chat-medium-q4_1`. Keep total under ~12m.

tyler_runtime: ok. propose three variants: 
  1) warmup_only (cache primed, short warmup)
  2) cold_cycles (full cold starts between each long prompt)
  3) cold+cache_off (no KV cache to simulate cache-miss).
Want fallback cpu-gen enabled for one trial?

emily: yes enable cpu fallback on variant 3 only. Also capture region slices: us, eu, apac. Tag artifacts with region label. Save raw responses for up to 3 failing seeds.

sam_ops: I can grab a 20m reserved slot on analytics-dedicated at 14:10 PT. Will pre-warm the node.

emily: please reserve it. annotate run id in the S3 prefix so we can pull quickly.

tyler_runtime: command we're using (automated wrapper):

```bash
./bench-runner --model redwood-chat-medium-q4_1 --payload s3://marketing-artifacts/webinar/demo-pack-v6.json --variants warmup_only,cold_cycles,cold_cacheoff_with_fallback --region-slices us,eu,apac --seed 2026 --warmup 80 --duration 720 --metrics per_token_p50,p90,p99,first_token_cold,oom_fallbacks --save-raw 3 --out s3://redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1737777000/
```

bench-bot: queued job 112233 on analytics-dedicated (ETA ~14m). Tag: marketing/webinar/demo-v6 :rocket:

ana_sales: Emily — we have inbound enterprise demos in EU next week. If eu p99 > 600ms please flag so I can prioritize routing.

emily: good call. mark threshold 600ms for EU.

tyler_runtime: run finished. Uploading manifest and metrics now. S3 link: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-results/marketing/webinar/1737777000/metrics.json

tyler_runtime: quick summary: overall p99 for cold_cacheoff peaked at ~1.02s on 2 long adversarial chains (apac slice), EU p99 at ~630ms for one long prompt. One OOM->cpu-fallback in variant cold_cacheoff_with_fallback (prompt_idx 33). Saved 3 raw captures.

emily: can you paste the manifest rows for the OOM/fallback and the EU spike?

tyler_runtime: manifest excerpt: `["{\"prompt_idx\":33,\"variant\":\"cold_cacheoff_with_fallback\",\"event\":\"oom\",\"fallback\":\"cpu_gen_q2\"}","{\"prompt_idx\":19,\"variant\":\"cold_cacheoff\",\"slice\":\"eu\",\"p99\":630}"]`

emily: perfect. tagging @ana_sales and @sam_ops. Ana — can you attach the metrics snapshot to the EU inbound ticket and ask product to delay an EU-heavy demo until we confirm warmup guidance?

ana_sales: will do. Adding a note: include the S3 manifest link and the failing prompt indices so Solutions can repro.

sam_ops: cleaning reserved slot now. artifacts retained for 5 days under the output prefix.

emily: thanks team. For slides we'll include a callout: "Dedicated, pre-warmed slot; warmup=80; seed=2026; measured on analytics-dedicated pool; shared results may vary." Also plan to avoid showing the two APAC adversarial cases.

tyler_runtime: sounds good. one more note — we observed a slight variance between warmup_only and cold_cycles p90 on short prompts (~30ms). Not material but worth noting if anyone asks.

emily: noted. thank you all :thumbsup:
